description: This file defines the CurlFactoryInterface interface within the GuzzleHttp\Handler namespace, declaring methods for creating and releasing cURL handles used in HTTP request handling.

classes.name: CurlFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for creating and releasing cURL handles in Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a cURL handle handle resource for a given request with specified options.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases an easy handle, allowing it to be reused or closed.
